digest.component_or_area: Repository-wide code, architecture, documentation, and test quality assessment
propositions: Multiple source modules (87 instances) exceed the 500-LOC documentation target, with representative hotspots like next_batch.py:compute() combining resolution, replay, BFS, and scheduling logic in a single function
Broad mypy passes globally but a --disallow-untyped-defs diagnostic found 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce strict typing, leaving most packages with shallow type coverage

Documentation examples in README and user-guide contradict reconciler behavior: --assignee examples omit required email/accountId, and old config paths (.rebar/config.conf) remain in workflow documentation despite current rebar.toml structure

Python 3.11 xdist worker dies repeatedly in test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted with 'node down: Not properly terminated' after ~11.4k tests, causing spurious CI failures and 8–24 minute rerun latency
Mutation testing evidence is stale and non-gating: docs/mutation-testing.md records June/July 2026 scores with no scheduled mutmut CI lane, so regressions are not detected

Two test-environment assumptions cause reproducible failures: test_help_overview_coverage.py recursively decodes all src/ files as UTF-8 (failing on binary node_modules), and test_attestation_signing.py assumes a full historical Git checkout (failing on promisor clones)
